test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a public sector industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BHEL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)** is an Indian public sector engineering and manufacturing company.
 
• It is owned by the Government of India and was established in 1964.
 
• BHEL is one of the largest engineering and manufacturing companies of its kind in India.
 
• The company is engaged in the design, engineering, construction, testing, commissioning, and servicing of a wide range of products and services for the core sectors of the economy, viz. Power, Transmission, Industry, Transportation (Railways), Renewable Energy, Oil & Gas, and Defence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reliance Industries Limited**

 
 
• It is a private sector company and one of the largest conglomerates in India.
 
• Founded by Dhirubhai Ambani in 1966, it is involved in various sectors including petrochemicals, refining, oil, telecommunications, and retail.
 
 
 
• **Tata Group**
 
 
• It is an Indian multinational conglomerate founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata.
 
• While it operates in many sectors including steel, automobiles, IT, and hotels, it is a private sector entity.
 
 
 
• **Adani Group**
 
 
• Founded by Gautam Adani in 1988, it is an Indian multinational conglomerate.
 
• It operates in sectors such as energy, resources, logistics, agribusiness, real estate, financial services, and defense.
 
• It is a private sector company.
 
 

This code provides a detailed explanation for the question, including key points about the correct option (BHEL) and additional information about the other options
